entry.name: rnbo_spline6interp
entry.description: Perform 6-point, 5th-order B-spline (x-form) interpolation on event input. The interpolated shape of the spline6 is determined by four keyframe points (w, x, y, and z). The output curve is the segment between the middle two points (x and y).
